chase mclaughlin.text: McLaughlin is slated to be Tampa Bay's primary placekicker for the fourth consecutive campaign in 2026.

kenny gainwell.text: Gainwell is one of three running backs on Tampa Bay's 53-man roster, along with Bucky Irving and Sean Tucker (undisclosed), the latter of whom didn't practice Wednesday, per Greg Auman of Fox Sports.

bucky irving.text: Irving is set to lead a Buccaneers backfield that also includes Kenny Gainwell and Sean Tucker (undisclosed), the latter of whom didn't practice Wednesday, per Greg Auman of Fox Sports.

chris godwin.text: Buccaneers general manager Jason Licht praised Godwin on Monday for his consistency and veteran leadership, Brianna Dix of the team's official site reports.

billy schrauth.text: Schrauth (knee) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

keionte scott.text: Scott (knee) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

mohamed kamara.text: Kamara (knee) reverted to the Buccaneers' injured reserve list Monday, per the NFL's transaction log. Expected return 2027-02-15.

david sills v.text: Sills (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Sunday with a designation to return, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports. Expected return 2026-10-08.

jalon daniels.text: Daniels is moving forward as Tampa Bay's backup quarterback behind Baker Mayfield after impressing throughout training camp, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

tez johnson.text: Johnson secured one of three targets for nine yards in the Buccaneers' 19-0 preseason loss to the Jaguars on Friday.

rueben bain.text: Bain sustained an AC sprain, but the injury is not believed to be serious, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Expected return 2026-09-13.

deshawn mcknight.text: The Buccaneers placed McKnight (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Scott Smith of the team's official site reports. Expected return 2027-02-15.

tristan wirfs.text: Wirfs (hamstring) practiced in full-team drills Tuesday, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

ted hurst.text: Hurst failed to bring in his only target in the Buccaneers' 16-15 preseason win over the Chiefs on Saturday.

zyon mccollum.text: McCollum (groin) practiced Thursday and might even see some snaps in Saturday's preseason game against the Chiefs, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

vita vea.text: Vea (back) and the Buccaneers reached an agreement on a one-year, $30 million extension Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

david walker.text: Walker (knee) passed his physical and is back to full health for training camp, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

benjamin morrison.text: Morrison (hamstring) was a full participant in Sunday's training camp practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

wan'dale robinson.text: Robinson (head) is not on the Titans' injury report.

carnell tate.text: Tate (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of the Titans' season opener against the Jets, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

cedric gray.text: Gray got in a UTV accident over the weekend and had to enter the NFL's concussion protocol, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports. Expected return 2026-09-13.

cam ward.text: New offensive coordinator Brian Daboll has worked with Ward to hone in his decision making ahead of the 2026 season, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

tyjae spears.text: Spears is among the four running backs that made the Titans' initial 53-man roster.

tony pollard.text: Pollard is set to lead a group of four running backs that made the Titans' initial 53-man roster.

calvin ridley.text: Ridley is among the five wide receivers on the Titans' initial 53-man roster.

gunnar helm.text: Helm finished the preseason slate with one catch (on two targets) for 16 yards in two appearances.

kendell brooks.text: Brooks (undisclosed) reverted to Tennessee's injured reserve Monday, per the NFL's transaction log. Expected return 2027-02-15.

melvin smith.text: The Titans claimed Smith off waivers Monday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

andre james.text: The Titans placed James (undisclosed) on injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports. Expected return 2026-09-13.

tanoh kpassagnon.text: The Titans placed Kpassagnon (undisclosed) on injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports. Expected return 2027-02-15.

dorian mausi.text: The Titans placed Mausi (undisclosed) on injured reserve Monday with a designation to return, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports. Expected return 2026-10-11.

joshua williams.text: The Titans placed Williams (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday with a designation to return, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports. Expected return 2026-10-11.

chimere dike.text: Dike secured one of two targets for nine yards in the Titans' 24-15 preseason loss to the Bears on Saturday.

nicholas singleton.text: Singleton rushed seven times for 26 yards and brought in both targets for 18 yards in the Titans' 24-15 preseason loss to the Bears on Saturday.

joey slye.text: Slye converted all four of his field-goal attempts and made his only PAT try in Sunday's 19-16 preseason win over the Seahawks.

elic ayomanor.text: Ayomanor (shoulder) is practicing Friday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

mario goodrich.text: The Titans signed Goodrich to a contract Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

marcus harris.text: Harris (knee) has been participating fully in training camp practices, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

rachaad white.text: White (hamstring) wasn't listed on the Commanders' initial Week 1 injury report Wednesday.

jacory croskey-merritt.text: Croskey-Merritt practiced in a limited capacity Wednesday due to a groin injury. Expected return 2026-09-13.

odafe oweh.text: Oweh (calf) took part in the Commanders' walk-through session Monday, JP Finlay of NBC Sports Washington reports. Expected return 2026-09-13.

athan kaliakmanis.text: Kaliakmanis made the Commanders' 53-man roster as the third-string quarterback, but he could be the team's backup for Week 1 against the Eagles if Marcus Mariota (knee) is not cleared to play.

chig okonkwo.text: Okonkwo is listed as a starting tight end on the Commanders' unofficial depth chart.

jayden daniels.text: Daniels played just one possession during the Commanders' three-game preseason slate, failing to complete his only pass.

terry mclaurin.text: McLaurin is set to lead a group of seven wide receivers that made Washington's initial 53-man roster.

stefon diggs.text: Diggs is among the seven wide receivers on Washington's initial 53-man roster.

k'lavon chaisson.text: Chaisson (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

shy tuttle.text: The Commanders re-signed Tuttle on Monday.

fabian moreau.text: The Commanders re-signed Moreau on Monday.

jer'zhan newton.text: The Commanders placed Newton (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday. Expected return 2026-11-23.

laremy tunsil.text: The Commanders placed Tunsil (triceps) on injured reserve Monday. Expected return 2026-12-20.

marcus mariota.text: Mariota (knee) returned to practice Monday, JP Finlay of NBC Sports Washington reports.

deatrich wise.text: Wise (undisclosed) was placed on the reserve/PUP list on Sunday. Expected return 2026-10-11.

trey amos.text: Amos (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Sunday with a designation to return. Expected return 2026-10-11.

jeremy mcnichols.text: The Commanders placed McNichols (quadriceps) on injured reserve with a designation to return Sunday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports. Expected return 2026-10-11.

antonio williams.text: Williams didn't play in Friday's preseason loss to the Ravens.

luke mccaffrey.text: McCaffrey caught one of three targets for 17 yards in Friday's 41-3 preseason loss to the Ravens.

kaytron allen.text: Allen carried the ball three times for four yards and lost a fumble in Friday's 41-3 preseason loss to the Ravens. He added nine yards on one kickoff return.

dj humphries.text: The Commanders signed Humphries to a one-year deal Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

ben sinnott.text: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Sinnott is dealing with an oblique injury and is unlikely to play in Friday's preseason finale versus the Ravens, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

tim settle.text: Settle (calf) will not play against the Lions in Saturday's preseason game. Expected return 2026-09-13.

nick allegretti.text: Allegretti (calf) will not play in Saturday's preseason game against Detroit, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports. Expected return 2026-09-13.

jordan magee.text: Magee suffered a shoulder injury during Friday's preseason opener against the Dolphins, Nicki Jhabvala of The Washington Post reports. Expected return 2026-09-13.
